counties.note: RSAG AöR (Rhein-Sieg-Abfallwirtschaftsgesellschaft, the Kreis's own institution) publishes one street-level calendar at rsag.de/abfallkalender/abfuhrtermine/. The landing page names all 19 Kreis towns. The calendar is built into rsag.de with no vendor, and it offers an ICS file and PDFs.

GWA Kreis Unna publishes one online calendar at gwa-online.de/abfallkalender/, which embeds the regioit abfallnavi widget (abfallnavi.de/unna). Its town API (abfallapp.regioit.de/abfall-app-unna/rest/orte) lists all 10 Kreis towns, including Fröndenberg. The widget builds ICS and PDF export URLs from abfallkalender.regioit.de/kalender-unna/downloadfile.jsp. Collection itself is split: KommunalService Wickede-Fröndenberg handles residual waste, bio and paper; GWA RE handles recyclables. The dates are nonetheless in the one GWA calendar.

Entsorgungswirtschaft Soest GmbH (ESG, the Kreis Soest waste company) publishes one street-level Abfallkalender for all 14 towns at esg-soest.de/abfallkalender/<town>; each street result offers a .ics download ('herunterladen') plus print view and e-mail reminders. Towns (e.g. soest.de Müllabfuhr page) link to it.

Collection is municipal, but the county's A.V.E. (Kommunaler Beratungsservice) hosts each town's 2026 Abfallkalender as a PDF at ave-kreis-paderborn.de/abfallkalender/<town>/. No official street-search or ICS found; towns (Büren, Borchen, Bad Wünnenberg) point residents to the MyMüll app as the digital option (named by the towns themselves).

Märkischer Kreis leaves collection to the towns. Seven of them (Altena, Balve, Iserlohn, Menden, Nachrodt-Wiblingwerde, Plettenberg, Werdohl) are served by the Zweckverband für Abfallbeseitigung (ZfA Iserlohn), each on its own page at zfa-iserlohn.de/<town>/leerungstermine/ with a street search and an ICS file per street. Kierspe and Meinerzhagen use Lobbe's lobbe.app (ICS). Schalksmühle embeds schalksmuehle.abfall-app.net. Hemer and Herscheid publish PDFs only (Herscheid also names the Remondis app). Neuenrade runs its own street selector on neuenrade.de.

All six towns in this batch are collected by the ASTO (Abfall-Sammel- und Transportverband Oberberg). Each has a page at asto.de/digital/<town> that embeds an abfuhrkalender.asto.de street finder; a street's result page has an iCal export (district-ical, action=iCalExport). Other Oberberg towns belong to BAV (Abfallnavi).

Hochsauerlandkreis only disposes; each town organises collection with a contractor (mostly Lobbe, Remondis in Schmallenberg/Eslohe). Olsberg and Winterberg embed a Stratmann street-picker widget, Medebach runs a Citkomm street form, Brilon and Meschede link lobbe.app. Bestwig, Eslohe, Marsberg and Sundern (Stadtwerke) publish a PDF only. For Hallenberg I found nothing current on the official site.

Kreis Wesel/AEZ Asdonkshof disposes; the AEZ page 'Service der Kommunen' links each town's own calendar page. Formats vary: static ICS per district (Hünxe), a Jumomind iframe (Kamp-Lintfort), mywastewatcher (Hamminkeln), and PDF only (Rheinberg, Schermbeck, Wesel/ASG).
Towns collect themselves. Kleve does it through USK (Umweltbetriebe der Stadt Kleve AöR), which offers a PDF plus the Bürger-App. Wachtendonk publishes a static ICS per Bezirk on its own site.

Kreis Mettmann: each town publishes its own calendar. Erkrath embeds a regioit calendar. Mettmann, Ratingen and Wülfrath link umwelt-webmedia.de tools. Velbert's comes from TBV AöR, and Haan, Hilden and Monheim run their own site modules. Langenfeld and Heiligenhaus offer only a PDF plus the MyMüll app, which each town names itself.

Kreis Minden-Lübbecke: each municipality publishes its own dates. Espelkamp and Pr. Oldendorf use a street calendar with iCal export on their own sites. Hille and Hüllhorst post static ICS files, Petershagen uses mein-abfallkalender.online and Bad Oeynhausen's Stadtwerke link a PreZero calendar. Rahden and Stemwede publish PDFs only.

Only Rösrath was checked. Its calendar comes from StadtWerke Rösrath, a municipal company, with a street picker and an ICS download. BAV is the disposal Zweckverband and does not publish Rösrath's collection calendar.

Kreis Siegen-Wittgenstein only runs disposal. Each town publishes its own calendar: Advantic/iKISS modules on the town sites (Bad Berleburg, Hilchenbach, Netphen, Neunkirchen, Wilnsdorf), SEDRO abfuhrtermine.info for Kreuztal, AWIDO for Burbach, plain district ICS files for Erndtebrück, and PDF plus the RE:MINDER app for Freudenberg. Bad Laasphe's site is behind a bot wall.

Kreis Olpe: each town runs its own calendar. Six of the seven link a SEDRO portal at <town>.abfuhrtermine.info that offers street selection and an ICS export per street. Kirchhundem instead uses an iKISS Abfalltermine module on its own site.
Kreisfreie Stadt. Collection is run by MEG (Mülheimer Entsorgungsgesellschaft), whose site embeds the regioIT abfallnavi at abfallnavi.de/muelheim; that navi has PDF and ICS export per street.
Only Verl was in this batch. Stadt Verl publishes its own calendar: a digital calendar that creates ICS by Abfuhrbezirk 1-5, plus the Umweltkalender PDF.

Rhein-Erft-Kreis: every town publishes its own calendar, usually through a municipal company (SWBM Bergheim, Stadtbetrieb Frechen, Stadtwerke Hürth, Entsorgungsbetriebe Wesseling) or the city itself (Brühl, Elsdorf, Pulheim via an embedded AbfallPlus widget, Erftstadt with REMONDIS as contractor). There is no county-wide calendar.

Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis: collection is municipal. AHE GmbH runs it for most towns and has an AbfallPlus street calendar at ahe.de/abfallkalender, plus per-town PDFs and the AHE app. Several towns run their own online calendars: Gevelsberg (Abfallmodul), Hattingen (insert-it), Herdecke (iCal), Wetter (Stadtbetrieb, mein-abfallkalender) and Schwelm (TBS, ICS per district).
Kreis Höxter: Beverungen publishes its own city calendar as a PDF. The city page also names MyMüll.de.

Kreis Herford only handles disposal; every town runs its own street-picker calendar on the same municipal CMS (Advantic-style 'Abfallkalender' module, form name SFm). The result view offers 'Export in Kalenderanwendung (VCAL)' via export.php?mode=vcal, which was confirmed by submitting a street on all 9 towns. Herford city's calendar is run by SWK Herford on swk.herford.de.

Each town runs its own Betriebshof or AöR with a different system. Castrop-Rauxel (EUV AöR), Gladbeck (ZBG) and Herten (ZBH, durth-roos widget) have street pickers with ICS. Haltern uses Muellmax with an iCalendar file. Waltrop (V+E AöR) publishes per-district ICS files. Marl (ZBH) and Oer-Erkenschwick link the sector27 Muellkalender web app, which shows no export. Datteln (KSD) offers only PDF/Excel plus the sector27 app.
Only Dormagen was in this batch. Stadt Dormagen (collection by contractor EGN) links dormagen.mein-abfallkalender.online (Krissel), which offers iCalendar/webcal.
Only Detmold was in this batch. Stadt Detmold's Abfallwirtschaft runs its own abfuhrkalender.detmold.de with an ics download. Other Lippe towns were not examined.

towns.evidence: The page runs the ews_garbagecalendar app ('geben Sie Ihre Straße ein ... speichern Sie die Termine in Ihrem digitalen Kalender'). Its JS has 'iCal Termin' buttons that generate .ics files (text/calendar).

towns.name: Ratingen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Ratingen page links this umwelt-webmedia street tool (week/month/year list, PDF). The city's 2026 press release says 'Die Termine können auch in die Kalenderanwendungen auf mobilen Endgeräten übertragen werden', but I did not see the ICS button itself.

towns.name: Velbert, Stadt
towns.evidence: The TBV street search ('Über die Straßensuche finden Sie die Termine ... für 2026') returns the dates on the page plus 'Kalender 1./2. Halbjahr 2026 (PDF)' links. I found no iCal option.

towns.name: Wülfrath, Stadt
towns.evidence: wuelfrath.net links this umwelt-webmedia tool (Adressauswahl für WÜLFRATH, Abfuhrtermine 2026) for street-specific dates. It also offers importing the dates 'in den eigenen Kalender auf das Smartphone, Tablet oder den PC'.

towns.name: Bad Oeynhausen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Stadtwerke Abfallkalender page links abfallkalender.prezero.network/bad-oeynhausen (pick a street and house number) and says 'Der Abfallkalender kann als iCal-Datei heruntergeladen ... werden'.

towns.name: Espelkamp, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a street dropdown ('Bitte wählen Sie Ihre Straße! ... Sie haben auch die Möglichkeit, Ihre Abfuhrtermine in Ihrem Kalender abzuspeichern') plus the 2026 PDF.

towns.name: Hille
towns.evidence: The page offers ICS downloads per collection district ('Bezirk 1/2 - Ohne/Mit Erinnerung', /media/custom/3015_171x_1.ICS) plus the 2026 PDF. You pick a district, not a street.

towns.name: Hüllhorst
towns.evidence: The official service portal (where huellhorst.de/.../Abfuhrkalender redirects) says 'Über die folgenden Links können Sie alle Abfuhrtermine für das Jahr 2026 in Ihren eigenen Kalender importieren', with and without reminders. There is no street picker.

towns.name: Petershagen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city's 2026 notice names petershagen.mein-abfallkalender.online as its service page (calendar sorted by street, reminders 'als Eintrag im Smartphone-Kalender'). That page shows iCal/webcal options.

towns.name: Preußisch Oldendorf, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a 'Straße auswählen' search mask, and its abfall.js implements 'Liste Termine exportieren' via a waste-ical button with an alarm option. The city's news post confirms export to Outlook/Google.

towns.name: Rahden, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Müllabfuhr section only links PDFs (Abfall-Entsorgungskalender2026.pdf, Abfuhrtermine-1.1-cbm-2026.pdf). I found no street tool or ICS.

towns.name: Stemwede
towns.evidence: The Abfall page links gemeinde-stemwede-abfallkalender-2026.pdf and the 1.1 cbm dates PDF. I found no street search or ICS link.

towns.name: Rösrath, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a 'Bitte wählen Sie Ihre Straße aus' dropdown. It says the calendar file is saved to Downloads for 'Importieren' in your calendar program, and the StadtWerke announcement names the ICS download.

towns.name: Bad Berleburg, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Online-Abfallkalender has Ort and Strasse selects; the result for Bad Berleburg / Am Breitenbach showed 'Export in Kalenderanwendung' linking /output/abfall_export.php?mode=vcal.

towns.name: Burbach
towns.evidence: Burbach's Abfallservice page links 'Abfall-App (Browser-Version)', which redirects to the AWIDO web app 'BURBACH-App'; its markup contains #import/#androidICS ICS export sections.

towns.name: Erndtebrück
towns.evidence: The page links downloadable files per district ('Entsorgungstermine 2026 Bezirk 1-4' and gelbe Tonne Bezirk B-D as .ics) plus the Abfuhrkalender 2026 PDF; there is no street picker, the district comes from the PDF.

towns.name: Freudenberg, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page offers 'Abfuhrkalender 2026' as a PDF plus a 'Digitaler Abfuhrkalender' PDF that only points to the Remondis RE:MINDER app; I found no online street picker and no ICS.

towns.name: Hilchenbach, Stadt
towns.evidence: 'Abfallkalender online' has Ort and Straße selection; the result for Dahlbruch / Am Höchsten showed 'Abfuhrtermine gefunden' and a waste-ical-btn linking options.php?call=ical.

towns.name: Kreuztal, Stadt
towns.evidence: kreuztal.de's Abfuhrtermine page links kreuztal.abfuhrtermine.info ('Entsorgungsportal der Stadt Kreuztal - Straße wählen'), and a street calendar there offers /dates/exportDates/1/Ics.

towns.name: Bad Laasphe, Stadt
towns.evidence: Every fetch of stadt-badlaasphe.de returned a 403 'Bestätigen Sie, dass Sie ein Mensch sind' bot wall, so the URL comes from search results only and the format could not be checked.

towns.name: Netphen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Abfallentsorgung page has an Ort/Straße search plus per-Ortsteil 2026 PDFs; the result for Netphen / Bahnhofstraße showed 'Abfuhrtermine gefunden' with a waste-ical-btn (options.php?call=ical).

towns.name: Neunkirchen
towns.evidence: The Abfalltermine page has Ort/Straße selection; the result for Bahnhofstraße showed a 'Terminexport' button titled 'Termine im Format ICS exportieren'.

towns.name: Wilnsdorf
towns.evidence: Under 'Terminreihe für digitale Kalender' the page says it provides an ics-Datei or Kalender-URL once you pick Ortsteil and Straße in its form, and it also offers per-Ortsteil PDFs.

towns.name: Attendorn, Hansestadt
towns.evidence: attendorn.de's 'Abfallkalender online' link redirects to attendorn.abfuhrtermine.info ('Entsorgungsportal der Hansestadt Attendorn - Straße wählen'), whose street calendar offers /dates/exportDates/490/Ics.

towns.name: Drolshagen, Stadt
towns.evidence: Drolshagen's 'Abfallkalender und Abfallanmeldung online' page links to drolshagen.abfuhrtermine.info (street list), whose street calendar offers /dates/exportDates/75/Ics.

towns.name: Finnentrop
towns.evidence: finnentrop.de's Abfallentsorgung page links 'Abfallkalender online' to finnentrop.abfuhrtermine.info, whose street calendar offers /dates/exportDates/1/Ics.

towns.name: Kirchhundem
towns.evidence: The Abfallanmeldung page links 'Hier gehts zum Abfallkalender-Modul', an iKISS Abfalltermine form (Ort/Straße) whose abfall.js wires a waste-ical-btn export; I could not render a street result myself, and a 2026 PDF is also offered.

towns.name: Lennestadt, Stadt
towns.evidence: Lennestadt's Müllabfuhr page links 'Abfuhrtermine Lennestadt', which redirects to lennestadt.abfuhrtermine.info; its street calendar offers /dates/exportDates/3385/Ics.

towns.name: Olpe, Stadt
towns.evidence: olpe.de's 'Online Abfallportal' link redirects to olpe.abfuhrtermine.info (484 streets); a street calendar says 'Termine als ICS-Datei zum Import' and links /dates/exportDates/1/Ics.

towns.name: Wenden
towns.evidence: wenden.de's Abfallentsorgung page links https://wenden.abfuhrtermine.info/ ('Entsorgungsportal der Gemeinde Wenden - Straße wählen'), whose street calendar offers /dates/exportDates/1/Ics.

towns.name: Mülheim an der Ruhr, Stadt
towns.evidence: The mheg.de homepage embeds an iframe of https://abfallnavi.de/muelheim/ (regioIT abfallnavi), whose app bundle builds per-street export URLs with format=pdf and format=ics.

towns.name: Verl, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Digitaler Abfallkalender page has a form posting to createWastecalendarIcs, where residents pick an Abfuhrbezirk (1-5) and waste types for import into their calendar; the Umweltkalender 2026 PDF is also offered.

towns.name: Bedburg, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city Abfallentsorgung page links to the PDF bedburg.net/Entsorgungskalender2026.pdf, the 'Bürger App Bedburg' and the Drekopf info portal drekopf.bedburg.net. The portal redirects to buerger-portal-bedburg.azurewebsites.net/calendar, a JS app whose content could not be read.

towns.name: Bergheim, Stadt
towns.evidence: The SWBM Abfallkalender page lists 13 districts, each with a PDF and a .ics file (e.g. swbm.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Bergheim2026.ics).

towns.name: Brühl, Stadt
towns.evidence: bruehl.de/bs/abfall/abfallkalender.php says the street dates can be shown as a PDF or downloaded 'als importierfähige Datei im ICS-Format'. It links to this online service, whose street form posts to services.stadtservice-bruehl.de/abfallkalender/.

towns.name: Elsdorf, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city Abfall page offers the 2026 PDF and five district ICS files (Bezirk 1-5 listed by village). It also names the MyMüll app.

towns.name: Erftstadt, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city page offers the full and compact PDF calendars per district (Bezirk 1-7), a 'Digitaler Abfallkalender' link to the city Geoportal and the REMONDIS RE:MINDER app. No ICS was seen, and abfallkalender-erftstadt.de is a third-party site (himpler.com) the city does not link.

towns.name: Frechen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The interactive calendar has a street search and directory. Each street page (e.g. /breslauer-strasse-96) offers 'Jahreskalender importieren (iCal)'.

towns.name: Hürth, Stadt
towns.evidence: Residents pick an address and bins in an embedded calendar (iframe swhmobil.de/muellkalenderneu) with a 'Tonnenalarm' e-mail or push reminder. No ICS or PDF export was seen in the page or the iframe source.

towns.name: Pulheim, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city page embeds an AbfallPlus publisher widget (key 1f4b9959...). It tells residents to pick their street and waste types and 'laden dann die Termine als Kalenderdatei', and also offers the PDF.

towns.name: Wesseling, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a PDF of street-to-district assignments, the 2026 PDF calendar and a text version, plus an e-mail 'Tonnenerinnerung' at sww.tonnenerinnerung.de. No ICS is mentioned.

towns.name: Breckerfeld, Hansestadt
towns.evidence: The Breckerfeld city page only offers a PDF calendar with a street directory. AHE, which collects there, lists Breckerfeld on ahe.de/abfuhrtermine and runs an AbfallPlus address widget at ahe.de/abfallkalender, but the widget's town list and any ICS option could not be seen.

towns.name: Ennepetal, Stadt der Kluterthöhle
towns.evidence: The Ennepetal city news page says the calendar is available printed, as a download and in the AHE app. AHE's AbfallPlus widget at ahe.de/abfallkalender takes town, street and house number, but the town list and export options were not visible.

towns.name: Gevelsberg, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Abfallmodul has 'Ort auswählen'/'Straße auswählen' with list, month and year views. The linking Abfall page says you can build your personal calendar for your address and download it 'als PDF oder Kalenderdatei'.

towns.name: Hattingen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city Abfallentsorgung page links to the 'online-abfallkalender' at insert-it.de/BmsAbfallkalenderHattingen, where you enter street and house number. No ICS option was visible in the fetched content. The city also offers a PDF.

towns.name: Herdecke, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has you choose the collection place 'Herdecke' and then your street. It offers the calendar as a PDF, as a screen view or 'Abfuhrkalender als iCal'.

towns.name: Schwelm, Stadt
towns.evidence: The TBS page has a Straßenverzeichnis 2026 that maps each street to an Abfuhrbezirk. Each district (1-4) links to a PDF and an 'ICS-Datei (Kalenderdatei)'.

towns.name: Sprockhövel, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Sprockhövel city page offers the PDF (abfallkalender-2026.pdf) and the AHE app. AHE lists Sprockhövel and has an AbfallPlus address widget at ahe.de/abfallkalender, whose town list and export options could not be seen.

towns.name: Wetter (Ruhr), Stadt
towns.evidence: The Stadtbetrieb page links the 'Online-Abfuhrkalender - WebApp'. That web app has a street dropdown for all of Wetter and an 'iCal / WebCal' export.

towns.name: Witten, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city page offers the Abfallkalender 2026 PDF with a street directory and mentions the AHE app, which it says is iOS-only. No online street search or ICS is linked there, though AHE's AbfallPlus widget at ahe.de/abfallkalender may cover Witten.

towns.name: Beverungen, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city Abfallwirtschaft page offers the Abfallkalender 2025/2026 PDFs with all collection areas and names MyMuell.de as a resource. There is no street search or ICS on the city's own site.

towns.name: Bünde, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a street select with 827 streets. Submitting one returned a result with export.php?mode=vcal (VCAL export) and PDF links.

towns.name: Enger, Widukindstadt
towns.evidence: The page has a street select with 585 streets. The result view contains the export.php?mode=vcal calendar export and PDF links.

towns.name: Herford, Hansestadt
towns.evidence: The 'Abfallkalender / SWK Herford' page has a street select with 849 streets. The result contains the mode=vcal 'Export in Kalenderanwendung' link.

towns.name: Hiddenhausen
towns.evidence: The page says dates can be exported as an ics file. Submitting a street returned a result with the mode=vcal export link.

towns.name: Kirchlengern
towns.evidence: The page has a 'Straße' select form. The result for a street showed 'Export in Kalenderanwendung' (export.php?mode=vcal) plus PDF, and a Hoch5 app is also offered.

towns.name: Löhne, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page has a street select with 737 streets. The result contains the mode=vcal export and PDF calendar links.

towns.name: Rödinghausen
towns.evidence: The 'Abfuhrkalender / Rödinghausen' page has a street select with 294 streets. The result contains the mode=vcal export link.

towns.name: Spenge, Stadt
towns.evidence: The 'Online-Abfallkalender / Stadt Spenge' page has a street select with 338 streets. The result contains the mode=vcal (VCAL) export link.

towns.name: Vlotho, Stadt
towns.evidence: The 'Abfallkalender online / Stadt Vlotho' page has a street select with 392 streets. The result contains the mode=vcal export and PDF links.

towns.name: Castrop-Rauxel, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Leerungsabfrage page asks for Straße and Hausnummer and says dates can be downloaded as PDF or iCalendar file, or subscribed in iPhone/Google/Outlook.

towns.name: Datteln, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Müllkalender page offers only a 2026 PDF, an Excel file and a street-directory PDF, plus links to the sector27 'Müllkalender' app. It has no online street picker and no ICS.

towns.name: Gladbeck, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page loads its own abis_abfuhrkalender_web JS for street and house number. Its strings include 'ICS-Export', 'PDF-Export' and 'Termine für Kalender exportieren', and a ZBG news post confirms entering the street gives PDF and smartphone-calendar sync.

towns.name: Haltern am See, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city's Abfuhrkalender page links this Haltern-branded Muellmax calendar. Choosing a street there leads to a result view with 'PDF-Datei 2026' and 'iCalendar-Datei' buttons.

towns.name: Herten, Stadt
towns.evidence: herten.de/zbh links this 'Abfallkalender der Stadt Herten' (durth-roos), where you pick a street and house number. The result includes an icalendar/<street>.ics link titled 'Termine als Kalender importieren'.

towns.name: Marl, Stadt
towns.evidence: The zbh-marl.de homepage links muellkalender.sector27.de/muellkalender-marl.html, which is a JS web app. Its view/app scripts contain no ical, ics, pdf or export strings. zbh.marl.de's 'interaktiver Wertstoffkalender' page timed out.

towns.name: Oer-Erkenschwick, Stadt
towns.evidence: The city's /abfall page links this sector27 calendar for an individual address calendar, alongside a 2026 PDF and the sector27 app. The sector27 web app scripts show no ICS/export option.

towns.name: Waltrop, Stadt
towns.evidence: The page offers a street directory to find your Bezirk, then a PDF and an .ics iCalendar file for each of Bezirk 1-8 for 2026. It is not a street picker.

towns.name: Dormagen, Stadt
towns.evidence: dormagen.de links 'Mein-Abfallkalender der Stadt Dormagen' (Krissel), which has street autocomplete and offers iCalendar export and webcal subscription for Outlook, Google and Apple.

towns.name: Detmold, Stadt
towns.evidence: The Stadt Detmold-branded abfuhrkalender.detmold.de has you pick a first letter and then a street, and states 'Weitere Informationen (inklusive Download ics-Datei iCal)'.
